Its analytic role is now encoded as a typed obligation in the new module Goldbach/Bridge/TS6LargeSieveInterface.lean (Phase 6.1): three structures (LargeSieveInequality, ChebyshevThetaBound, SpectralBridgeFromLargeSieve) plus one composition theorem (spectral_bridge_via_large_sieve). predicted.claim: Replacement of the cosmetic `axiom spectral_bridge_GRH : True` by the typed bridge in Goldbach.Bridge.TS6LargeSieveInterface will produce zero axiom delta across the 11 verified theorems. Reason: no caller in the current G26 scope constructs an instance of `ProofPillars` requiring a `SpectralBridgeFromLargeSieve` witness, nor invokes `spectral_bridge_via_large_sieve` directly.

observed.claim: Zero axiom delta. All 11 verified theorems retain identical axiom signatures between v6 fusion (tag g26-v6-fusion-merged) and v7 bridge (Phase 6.2 commit 69db595).

phase6_bridge_calibration.diagnosis: Same structural reason as Phase 5 v6: the typed obligation is encoded but not consumed by any caller in the current G26Verify scope. The analytic dependency (Large Sieve inequality + effective Chebyshev bound + Bombieri-Vinogradov-pointwise) is now machine-enforceable for any future caller that constructs a `ProofPillars` or invokes `spectral_bridge_via_large_sieve`, but remains inert in the verified-theorem dependency closure. Improvement is type-structural, not axiomatic.
phase6_bridge_calibration.methodological_lesson: Second confirmation of the Phase 5 lesson: type-structural improvements without new callers produce zero axiomatic delta. Predictions calibrated against this pattern are now validated twice consecutively. For future refactors of this kind, expect zero delta as the baseline; the benefit is contract enforceability, not axiom visibility.

lean_46_to_415_drift_register.drift: renamed to `pow_le_pow_left₀` (Mathlib convention: ₀ suffix for variant with explicit ≠ 0 hypothesis)
ContDiff reparameterized from ℕ∞ to WithTop ℕ∞; `⊤` now denotes analyticity, not C∞ smoothness
These notations are not in Lean core — they belong to Mathlib (require Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic or Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic). A bare `import` of nothing fails for any module using them.
lean_46_to_415_drift_register.resolution: Add `import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic` as the sole dependency of TS6LargeSieveInterface.lean. Methodological note archived in audit/phase6_axiom_delta.md.

lean_46_to_415_drift_register.drift: Removing a declaration preceded by a `/-- ... -/` doc-comment leaves the comment orphaned, causing parse error 'unexpected token <next>; expected lemma'. Recurrent: also observed in Phase 1a on HorizonCertified.lean.
lean_46_to_415_drift_register.resolution: Convert `/--` → `/-` (regular block comment, no declaration requirement). Pattern archived as a pre-execution checklist item for future refactors.
